administrator_login.description: (Optional) The Administrator login for the server. Required when password authentication is enabled.
administrator_login.title: Administrator login

administrator_password.description: (Optional) The Password associated with the administrator_login.
administrator_password.title: Administrator password

backup_retention_days.description: (Optional) The backup retention days for the server (7-35).
backup_retention_days.title: Backup retention days

delegated_subnet_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the subnet delegated to Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers (VNet integration). When set, public network access is disabled.
delegated_subnet_id.title: Delegated subnet id

geo_redundant_backup_enabled.description: (Optional) Is Geo-Redundant backup enabled on the server?
geo_redundant_backup_enabled.title: Geo redundant backup enabled

high_availability_mode.description: (Optional) The high availability mode: SameZone or ZoneRedundant. Leave null to disable high availability.
high_availability_mode.title: High availability mode

name.description: (Required) The name of the PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Name

private_dns_zone_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the private DNS zone used with VNet integration. Required when delegated_subnet_id is set.
private_dns_zone_id.title: Private dns zone id

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Is public network access enabled? Forced to false when delegated_subnet_id is set.
public_network_access_enabled.title: Public network access enabled

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

server_version.description: (Optional) The version of PostgreSQL Flexible Server to use. Possible values are 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17.
server_version.title: Server version

sku_name.description: (Optional) The SKU Name for the server, e.g. B_Standard_B1ms, GP_Standard_D2s_v3, MO_Standard_E4s_v3.
sku_name.title: Sku name

standby_availability_zone.description: (Optional) The availability zone of the standby server when high availability is enabled.
standby_availability_zone.title: Standby availability zone

storage_mb.description: (Optional) The max storage allowed for the server in MB.
storage_mb.title: Storage mb

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags

tenant_id.description: (Optional) The Tenant ID for Microsoft Entra authentication. Required when active_directory_auth_enabled is true.
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

zone.description: (Optional) The Availability Zone of the server.
zone.title: Zone
